text: In Germany a flat is described by its number of rooms, not bedrooms: a 3-Zimmer-Wohnung has three rooms, usually not counting the kitchen and bathroom. Its size is given in square metres, for example 2 Zimmer, 55 m².

The monthly rent is quoted as Kaltmiete (rent without heating and service charges) or Warmmiete (including them, the Nebenkosten). Tenants normally pay a deposit, the Kaution, of up to three months’ Kaltmiete.
